items.title: China advises its citizens to leave Taiwan ally Eswatini over 'security risks'
items.dek: Eswatini is one of 12 countries, and the only one in Africa, that has diplomatic relations with Taiwan.

items.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
items.dek: A hospital official told the BBC that the door to the ward was not locked, but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.
